name: Cassini
tagline: After years among Saturn’s rings and moons, Cassini made one final, deliberate journey into the planet it had come to know.
credit: Original editorial illustration created for the Left Behind archive.

beats.goal: Study Saturn, its rings, and its moons in unprecedented detail.
beats.achieved: Cassini transformed our understanding of the Saturn system, discovering active geysers on Enceladus, studying Titan's lakes and atmosphere, and revealing the complexity of Saturn's rings.
beats.ending: To avoid accidentally contaminating moons that may contain the ingredients for life, NASA intentionally directed Cassini into Saturn's atmosphere on September 15, 2017. It continued sending scientific data until the signal was finally lost.
beats.now: Cassini became part of Saturn's atmosphere, ending one of NASA's most successful planetary missions.
beats.learned: Its discoveries reshaped our understanding of ocean worlds and helped guide future missions searching for life beyond Earth.
